errors.evidence: The blue "Train" line starts at approximately 45% at epoch 0, not 48.7%.
The blue "Train" line reaches 100% accuracy around epoch 27 and stays there until the end of the range. The value at epoch 30 is 100%, not 97.8%.
The line representing the "Validation" dataset is a solid green line, not a dashed line.
The green "Validation" line starts at the same point as the train line, approximately 45% at epoch 0, not 52.1%.
The green "Validation" line's last data point is near epoch 29, with a value of approximately 82.5%. The value 83.9% is incorrect and overly precise.
